items.q: Match the onset proportions — 1) Ascites due to portal hypertension 2) Ascites due to peritoneal causes 3) PHTN from cirrhosis 4) PHTN without cirrhosis … A) 85% B) 90% C) 10% D) 5%
items.exp: Onset: 90% d/t portal hypertension (PHTN), 10% d/t peritoneal causes; of PHTN, 85% cirrhosis and 5% no cirrhosis. (Book p1005)

items.q: In a hospital series of 200 new ascites patients, applying only epidemiologic proportions, how many would have portal-hypertensive ascites due to cirrhosis?
items.exp: 200 × 90% = 180 portal-hypertensive; 85% of those (153) are cirrhotic per the p1005 onset tree. (Book p1005)
